pins.claim: Accepted option letters are c i l m n p s (all regexp functions) plus g (regexp_replace only); any other character is rejected. Bogus 'q' errors identically in regexp_matches/regexp_extract/regexp_replace.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'q')
SELECT regexp_extract('a', 'a', 0, 'q')
SELECT regexp_replace('a', 'a', 'x', 'q')
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option q
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option q
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option q

pins.claim: 'x' (extended/free-spacing) is NOT a valid option letter, and option letters are case-sensitive (uppercase 'I' rejected) — same 'Unrecognized Regex option' error shape for each.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'x')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'I')
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option x
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option I

pins.claim: 'c' = case-sensitive matching (the default): 'ABC' vs 'abc' with 'c' is false.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'c')

pins.claim: 'i' = case-insensitive matching: 'ABC' vs 'abc' with 'i' is true; works in extract (returns 'ABC') and replace (replaces first 'A').
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'i')
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', '(abc)', 1, 'i')
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', 'a', 'x', 'i')

pins.claim: 'l' = literal matching: metacharacters lose meaning. 'a.c' with 'l' matches only the literal string 'a.c', not 'abc' (which the same pattern matches without 'l').
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('a.c', 'a.c', 'l'), regexp_matches('abc', 'a.c', 'l'), regexp_matches('abc', 'a.c')

pins.claim: 'l' composes with 'i' ('il' = literal case-insensitive: 'A.C' vs pattern 'a.c' is true), and under 'l' inline-flag syntax is literal text (pattern '(?i)abc' with 'l' matches the literal string '(?i)abc').
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('A.C', 'a.c', 'il')
SELECT regexp_matches('(?i)abc', '(?i)abc', 'l')

pins.claim: 's' = dot matches newline (dotall): 'a'||chr(10)||'b' vs 'a.b' is false by default and true with 's'.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 's')

pins.claim: 'm', 'n', 'p' are all accepted and all mean newline-sensitive matching, which is already the default: dot still does not match chr(10) under any of them.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 'm')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 'n')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 'p')

pins.claim: SURPRISE: 'm'/'n'/'p' do NOT turn ^/$ into per-line anchors. '^b$' (and even '^a$') against 'a'||chr(10)||'b' is false with 'm', 'n', and 'p'.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^b$', 'm')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^b$', 'n')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^b$', 'p')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^a$', 'm')

pins.claim: Multiline anchors come ONLY from the inline flag: '(?m)^b$' matches 'a'||chr(10)||'b' (true), including when options 'n' or 's' are also passed.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?m)^b$')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?m)^b$', 'n')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?m)^b$', 's')

pins.claim: 'n' is NOT RE2 never_nl: a pattern containing a literal newline, the escape \n, or [\s\S] still matches across chr(10) with 'n'.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'n')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a\nb', 'n')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a[\s\S]b', 'n')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a[\s\S]b')

pins.claim: 'g' is only valid in regexp_replace; in regexp_matches, regexp_extract, and regexp_extract_all it raises the same verbatim error.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'g')
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', '(abc)', 1, 'g')
SELECT regexp_extract_all('aAbA', 'a', 0, 'g')
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Option 'g' (global replace) is only valid for regexp_replace
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Option 'g' (global replace) is only valid for regexp_replace
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Option 'g' (global replace) is only valid for regexp_replace

pins.claim: regexp_replace replaces only the FIRST match by default; 'g' makes it global. Combined 'gi'/'ig' both give global case-insensitive.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', 'a', 'x')
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', 'a', 'x', 'g')
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', 'a', 'x', 'gi')
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', 'a', 'x', 'ig')

pins.claim: Empty options string '' is identical to omitting the argument: no error, default (case-sensitive, non-dotall) behavior.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', '')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', '')
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', '(abc)', 1, '')
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', 'a', 'x', '')

pins.claim: Whitespace inside the options string is silently ignored (space, tab, newline all fine, including an options string that is only a space); any other separator such as ',' is an unrecognized option.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'i s')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'i' || chr(9) || 's')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'i' || chr(10) || 's')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', ' ')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'i,s')
pins.observed:
OK [(True,)]
OK [(True,)]
OK [(True,)]
OK [(False,)]
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option ,

pins.claim: SURPRISE: conflicting options do NOT error — the options string is processed left-to-right and the LAST occurrence wins: 'ci' is case-insensitive (true), 'ic' is case-sensitive (false), 'ici' insensitive again.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'ci')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'ic')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'ici')

pins.claim: Same last-wins rule for newline options: 'sn' behaves like 'n' (dot does not cross newline, false), 'ns' behaves like 's' (true).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 'sn')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 'ns')

pins.claim: Duplicate option letters are harmless: 'ii' and 'gg' work.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', 'ii')
SELECT regexp_replace('aaa', 'a', 'x', 'gg')

pins.claim: NULL options is an ERROR (not a NULL result): 'Regex options field must not be NULL'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', NULL)
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Regex options field must not be NULL

pins.claim: NULL pattern or NULL subject returns NULL (no error).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', NULL)
SELECT regexp_matches(NULL, 'abc')

pins.claim: The options argument must be a CONSTANT: sourcing it from a column errors 'Regex options field must be a constant' even when the value is a valid letter and even under WHERE 1=0 (bind-time check).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', 'abc', o) FROM (SELECT 'i' AS o) t
SELECT regexp_matches('a', 'a', o) FROM (SELECT 'q' AS o) WHERE 1=0
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Regex options field must be a constant
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Regex options field must be a constant

pins.claim: Empty pattern matches everything including the empty string; regexp_matches is a contains-style search, not a full match.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('abc', ''), regexp_matches('', '')
SELECT regexp_matches('xabcx', 'abc')

pins.claim: Inline flags (?i), (?s), (?m) are all accepted by RE2 inside DuckDB patterns.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', '(?i)abc')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?s)a.b')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?m)^b$')

pins.claim: (?U) (ungreedy) is accepted: '(?U)a+' extracts the shortest match 'a' from 'aaa'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('aaa', '(?U)a+')

pins.claim: (?x) (free-spacing) is NOT supported: 'invalid perl operator: (?x'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('abc', '(?x)a b c')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid perl operator: (?x

pins.claim: Inline flags compose with and OVERRIDE the options argument: '(?i)abc' with options 'c' still matches 'ABC' (true); '(?-i)abc' with options 'i' does not (false); '(?s)a.b' with options 'n' still crosses the newline (true).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', '(?i)abc', 'c')
SELECT regexp_matches('ABC', '(?-i)abc', 'i')
SELECT regexp_matches('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?s)a.b', 'n')
SELECT regexp_replace('AaAa', '(?i)a', 'x', 'g')

pins.claim: Pattern '[' (unclosed class): verbatim error 'Invalid Input Error: missing ]: ['. All pattern-compile and option errors are duckdb.InvalidInputException whose message is 'Invalid Input Error: ' + RE2's own error text.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', '[')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ]: [

pins.claim: Pattern '(' (unclosed group): verbatim error 'Invalid Input Error: missing ): ('.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', '(')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ): (

pins.claim: Pattern 'a{2,1}' (max<min): 'invalid repetition size: {2,1}'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', 'a{2,1}')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid repetition size: {2,1}

pins.claim: Pattern '(?P<n' (unterminated named group): 'invalid named capture group: (?P<n'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', '(?P<n')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid named capture group: (?P<n

pins.claim: Pattern 'a**': 'bad repetition operator: **'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', 'a**')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: bad repetition operator: **

pins.claim: Pattern that is a single backslash: 'trailing \'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', '\')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: trailing \

pins.claim: Backreference '(a)\1' is rejected (RE2 has no backrefs) as 'invalid escape sequence: \1'.
pins.query: SELECT regexp_matches('aab', '(a)\1')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid escape sequence: \1

pins.claim: Lookahead 'a(?=b)' and lookbehind '(?<=a)b' are rejected as 'invalid perl operator: (?=' / 'invalid perl operator: (?<'.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('aab', 'a(?=b)')
SELECT regexp_matches('aab', '(?<=a)b')
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid perl operator: (?=
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid perl operator: (?<

pins.claim: Counted repetition is capped at 1000: 'a{1000}' compiles, 'a{1001}' errors 'invalid repetition size: {1001}'.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a', 'a{1000}')
SELECT regexp_matches('a', 'a{1001}')
pins.observed:
OK [(False,)]
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: invalid repetition size: {1001}

pins.claim: Constant-pattern compile errors are BIND-time: they fire even with WHERE 1=0, under EXPLAIN, and at PREPARE (no rows ever executed).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches(s, '[') FROM (SELECT 'a' AS s) WHERE 1=0
EXPLAIN SELECT regexp_matches('a', '[')
PREPARE q1 AS SELECT regexp_matches('a', '[')
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ]: [
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ]: [
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ]: [

pins.claim: Column-sourced (non-constant) patterns compile at EXECUTION time: with WHERE 1=0 the bad pattern is never compiled and the query succeeds returning zero rows; when actually executed it raises the same 'missing ]: [' text.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a', p) FROM (SELECT '[' AS p) WHERE 1=0
SELECT regexp_matches('a', p) FROM (SELECT '[' AS p) t
pins.observed:
OK []
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ]: [

pins.claim: Constant bogus OPTIONS letters are also bind-time errors (fire under WHERE 1=0 and EXPLAIN).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches(s, 'a', 'q') FROM (SELECT 'a' AS s) WHERE 1=0
EXPLAIN SELECT regexp_matches('a', 'a', 'q')
pins.observed:
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option q
ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option q

pins.claim: 'i' uses RE2 simple Unicode folding: 'HÉLLO' matches 'héllo' (true) and ASCII 'ISTANBUL' matches 'istanbul' (true), but dotless-I folding is absent: 'İstanbul' does NOT match 'istanbul' with 'i' (false).
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('héllo', 'HÉLLO', 'i')
SELECT regexp_matches('istanbul', 'ISTANBUL', 'i')
SELECT regexp_matches('İstanbul', 'istanbul', 'i')

pins.claim: Patterns are UTF-8 aware: '.' matches one code point (emoji), literal option works on emoji, and global replace of an emoji works; but \d and [0-9] do NOT match Arabic-Indic digits '٣٤'.
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_matches('a😀b', '^a.b$')
SELECT regexp_matches('a😀b', 'a😀b', 'l')
SELECT regexp_replace('a😀b😀c', '😀', '-', 'g')
SELECT regexp_matches('٣٤', '\d'), regexp_matches('٣٤', '[0-9]')

surprises: 'm'/'n'/'p' are accepted but do NOT enable multiline ^/$ anchors — they are the (default) newline-sensitive mode; only inline (?m) gives per-line anchors.
Conflicting options never error: the options string is applied left-to-right, LAST letter wins ('ci' insensitive, 'ic' sensitive; 'sn' non-dotall, 'ns' dotall).
Whitespace (space/tab/newline) inside the options string is silently ignored; ',' errors 'Unrecognized Regex option ,'.
NULL options is an error ('Regex options field must not be NULL'), unlike NULL pattern/subject which return NULL.
Options must be a compile-time constant: any column-sourced options value errors 'Regex options field must be a constant' at bind time, even under WHERE 1=0.
'n' is not RE2 never_nl: literal newlines, \n, and [\s\S] in the pattern still match across chr(10) under 'n'.
Constant-pattern compile errors are bind-time (fire under EXPLAIN/PREPARE/WHERE 1=0); column-pattern compile errors are execution-time with the same message.
Counted repetition cap is exactly 1000: a{1000} ok, a{1001} 'invalid repetition size: {1001}'.
'i' folding is RE2 simple folding: accents fold but 'İstanbul' does not match 'istanbul'.
recommendation: Implement the options parser as: iterate chars left-to-right; skip whitespace; map c->case_sensitive, i->case_insensitive, l->literal, s->dot_nl(true), m/n/p->dot_nl(false), g->global (regexp_replace only, else error "Option 'g' (global replace) is only valid for regexp_replace"); any other char -> "Unrecognized Regex option <ch>". No conflict detection, last write wins. Options arg must be constant and non-NULL (distinct bind-time error texts). Do NOT map m/n/p to multiline anchors or never_nl. Compile constant patterns at bind (errors surface in EXPLAIN/PREPARE/WHERE false), non-constant patterns per-row at execution, both with error text 'Invalid Input Error: ' + RE2 message verbatim, as InvalidInputException.
